text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: say, speak, or utter; locally a direct 2ms imperative that turns the following exclusive stance into required public speech
words.root_gloss_range: saying, formulated speech, attribution, and responsible utterance; locally selected as commanded declaration rather than ordinary narration

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first-person imperfect invocation inside the quoted utterance
first-person imperfect refusal of association inside the quoted utterance

words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) opens the ayah by making the doctrine a commanded utterance. Its clipped imperative launch gives the speech frame abrupt command-impact before the longer restricted declaration unfolds. The following first-person verbs are not narrator summary; they are the words the addressee must voice, so exclusive invocation and refusal of association become accountable public witness rather than vague assent. The variant report reading is useful as contrast: the base imperative keeps the speech under direct command, while the reported form would present the same stance as completed testimony. The opening also answers the crowding scene of 72:19 by replacing pressure around the servant with controlled speech, and it belongs to a wider command-declaration mode that includes oneness proclamation (112:1) and a nearby run of regulated claims about power, refuge, and knowledge (72:21, 72:22, 72:25).

topics.headline: command turns belief into utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with an order to say the stance aloud, not with an unframed inner belief.
topics.reason: QAC parses a 2ms imperative, and attachment evidence makes the rest of the ayah its quoted complement.

topics.headline: command frames two first-person clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the commanded addressee and the spoken first-person stance together without collapsing the quote into narration.
topics.reason: The following first-person verbs are inside the quoted content governed by the opening speech command.

topics.headline: speech root carries accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the command as accountable wording whose content is invocation directed to the Lord, not generic speech.
topics.reason: The speech-root field coheres with the local quote and with the invocation and Lordship terms inside the utterance.

topics.headline: clipped launch gives command impact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the short imperative as an abrupt opening before the longer restricted declaration unfolds.
topics.reason: The local surface is a compact apocopated command from a weak root, and the sound rows add delivery pressure without changing syntax.

topics.headline: variant contrasts command and report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the canonical opening matters: command and report can carry the same content, but they assign different discourse agency.
topics.reason: The variant is useful as contrast, while the aligned local surface remains the imperative and therefore governs the prose.

topics.headline: speech answers the previous scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah as a boundary move from the pressured scene in 72:19 into a controlled first-person declaration.
topics.reason: The command follows the 72:19 scene and converts the prior narrative pressure into direct speech.

topics.headline: nearby command formula continues
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this opening as part of a broader command-speech mode, including oneness declaration (112:1) and nearby declarations in the same surah (72:21, 72:22, 72:25).
topics.reason: The concrete cross-references support formulaic command-speech comparison without replacing the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle; locally confines the positive invocation clause before the coordinated denial clause unfolds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the call-upon-my-Lord clause restricted by the particle
the coordinated negated association clause that follows the restriction

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَآ}} ({{tr:innamā}}) is the limiter that narrows the first clause before the denial arrives. It does not merely intensify; it sets the positive direction of calling, then the following negative clause protects that boundary. The fused particle also matters grammatically: the restraining element prevents ordinary governance by the emphatic particle and makes the following verb phrase the scoped content. Its lengthened surface gives the limiter audible weight before the verb, so the listener hears the limiting frame before the call unfolds. Against the massed crowd of 72:19, the particle turns attention from plurality around the servant to a single devotional direction.

topics.headline: positive clause is narrowed first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exclusivity is first stated positively as confined invocation, before the ayah denies association.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a restraining particle before the first quoted clause.

topics.headline: fusion creates limiter behavior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the following verb phrase is scoped by restriction rather than treated as an ordinary case-governed complement.
topics.reason: The input labels the particle as restrained/fused, supporting limiter behavior in the local clause.

topics.headline: restriction pivots into denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah's exclusivity as two-sided: the call has one direction, and association has no admitted partner.
topics.reason: The particle scopes the positive clause while the coordinated negated clause supplies the complementary refusal.

topics.headline: recitation weighs the limiter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the limiting frame held before the verb, so the call enters already constrained.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe delivery pressure on the local particle and do not conflict with the grammar.

topics.headline: restriction answers crowd pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the limiter as a response to the prior massed scene in 72:19, narrowing attention to one devotional object.
topics.reason: The boundary rows supply a concrete 72:19 contrast that fits the local restrictive particle.

words.gloss_range: call, invoke, or address; locally first-person ongoing worshipful invocation restricted to the speaker's Lord
words.root_gloss_range: calling, summoning, inviting, petitioning, and claiming; locally narrowed to direct invocation and dependence, not generic summons or authority-claim

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: restriction particle governing the invocation clause
the possessed Lord as direct object of the invocation

words.prose: {{ar:أَدْعُوا۟}} ({{tr:adʿū}}) gives the restricted clause its ongoing first-person action. The imperfect form presents calling as a stance, not a completed episode, and the object makes the call worshipful invocation rather than a neutral summons or a claim to possess authority. The simple verb form keeps the act as direct address, not causing someone else to call or respond. Because the word is spoken under the opening command, saying it performs the orientation it names. Its long ending carries the restricted call audibly toward the Lord-object. It also continues a same-surah thread: calling in 72:18 and 72:19 becomes here a first-person declaration, while the negative counterpart later in the ayah states what this directed invocation refuses.

topics.headline: ongoing first-person invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speaker personally inhabiting an ongoing stance of invocation rather than reporting a past act.
topics.reason: The verb is parsed as first-person imperfect inside the quoted utterance, with its subject supplied by morphology.

topics.headline: call is scoped by restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the action already confined by the limiter before the Lord-object completes it.
topics.reason: The restriction particle precedes the verb and the object follows as the explicitly called-upon referent.

topics.headline: Lord-object selects worshipful calling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the call as devotional address to the Lord, while broader summon and claim branches remain bounded by the local object.
topics.reason: The root range is broad, but the direct object is the speaker's Lord, selecting invocation/dependence rather than neutral summons or allegation.

topics.headline: direct call rather than causative routing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is direct address, not causing someone else to call.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form I in a direct object frame.

topics.headline: saying the call enacts it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the quoted statement performs the speaker's orientation while describing it.
topics.reason: The verb stands inside the commanded quote introduced by the opening speech imperative.

topics.headline: calling thread becomes first-person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the surah's call-language move from broader or third-person scenes (72:18, 72:19) into the speaker's own declaration in 72:20.
topics.reason: The cited same-surah occurrences provide a concrete thread without overriding the local first-person grammar.

topics.headline: positive verb balances negated counterpart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees invocation and nonassociation as the two halves of one stance: directed calling first, refused partnership second.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the later negated verb with this positive verb inside the quoted utterance.

topics.headline: long ending carries the call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the call flow into the Lord-object, matching the syntax that directs the invocation.
topics.reason: The sound observation reinforces the local verb-object movement.

words.gloss_range: my Lord; locally the singular possessed Lord as object of invocation and antecedent for the later pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, sustaining authority, nurture, formation, and care; locally selected as personal Lordship rather than an abstract title alone

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun resuming the Lord in the association clause

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّى}} ({{tr:rabbī}}) completes the positive call by naming the invoked referent as the speaker's own Lord. Its possessive suffix makes the title definite and personal, and that same referent is then resumed by the pronoun in the refusal of association. The root field adds more than bare naming: Lordship carries sustaining authority and care, so the speaker's call is directed to the one who owns, forms, and sustains. As a noun-title rather than a verbal process, the word presents Lordship as a stable relation. The singular possessed form also stands against the surrounding plurality: massed crowds and collective formulas give way here to one speaker before one Lord, while the same Lordship thread continues toward 72:22 and can be compared with universal Lordship (1:2) without losing the local first-person suffix.

topics.headline: Lord completes the positive call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the restricted calling land on a named object before the ayah turns to denial.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the direct object of the invocation verb.

topics.headline: suffix makes Lordship personal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim is not generic Lordship only; the speaker binds the invoked Lord to himself by possessive relation.
topics.reason: The noun is singular with a first-person possessive suffix and stands as the object of the call.

topics.headline: same referent resumes in pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one referent across both clauses: the Lord invoked is the same one with whom no partner is associated.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the later prepositional suffix back to this word.

topics.headline: root field adds sustaining authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the title as authority joined to nurture and dependence, while local grammar keeps the surface as the possessed Lord-object.
topics.reason: The Lordship root field supports authority, care, and formation as lexical pressure, but the local noun remains the object title.

topics.headline: title selected over verbal process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Lordship presented as a stable relation and title, not as a narrated process.
topics.reason: The local form is a concrete noun rather than a verb.

topics.headline: Lordship anchors the surah thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this personal Lordship wording as part of the surah's repeated Lordship frame, including the movement toward 72:22.
topics.reason: The same root and title recur in the surah and connect invocation with nonassociation.

topics.headline: personal Lordship echoes wider formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare personal Lordship here with universal Lordship in the opening formula (1:2), without losing the local first-person suffix.
topics.reason: The cross-reference is concrete and serves formulaic comparison, while local syntax remains possessive and personal.

topics.headline: singular title answers plurality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear and see the central singular object standing against the prior massed plurality.
topics.reason: The sound row and boundary row reinforce the local singular possessed noun without changing its role.

words.gloss_range: and; locally a coordinator that joins the positive restricted invocation clause to the negative association clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: visible negator beginning the coordinated denial

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is small but architectural: it binds the restricted call to the denial of association. The conjunction prevents the second clause from feeling like a new topic; it is the negative counterpart to the positive claim. Because it remains a separate word before the negator, the reader can see the pivot from affirmation to exclusion while still hearing one continuous stance.

topics.headline: coordination joins affirmation and denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exclusive worship is built from two coordinated clauses, not two unrelated statements.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the later verb as coordinated with the invocation verb inside the quoted utterance.

topics.headline: connector pivots into negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the clause move from the sole direction of calling into the refusal of every rival relation.
topics.reason: The conjunction sits between the restricted positive clause and the negated association clause.

topics.headline: separate connector preserves boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can both see the grammatical boundary before negation and hear the joined movement into it.
topics.reason: The coordinator is split from the negator in the bundle, while recitation still links the movement into the negative clause.

topics.headline: coordination remains primary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may feel semantic accompaniment between affirmation and denial, while local syntax keeps the word functioning as a coordinator.
topics.reason: The local grammar identifies a conjunction; any accompaniment pressure supports the pairing rather than replacing coordination.

words.gloss_range: not; locally a clausal negator before an imperfect verb, opening a denial whose scope reaches the final indefinite object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the imperfect association verb negated by the particle
the indefinite object over which the negation becomes exhaustive

words.prose: {{ar:لَآ}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the negative half of the declaration. It negates the following imperfect as a present stance, not as a prohibition addressed to someone else. Its scope remains open until the final indefinite object, so the reader does not get only a denied act; the clause gradually becomes a total exclusion of any partner. The lengthened surface gives the negating boundary audible space before the association verb arrives.

topics.headline: negation of stated stance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the clause as the speaker's denial of association, not as a prohibition command.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a negative particle before an imperfect verb, and attachment evidence places it in the quoted stance.

topics.headline: negation reaches final object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits through the clause until the final indefinite object shows that no candidate remains in the association slot.
topics.reason: The negator governs the association verb, whose object is the final indefinite noun.

topics.headline: separate negator marks the turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the coordinated negative clause begin distinctly after the conjunction.
topics.reason: The negator is a separate word after the coordinator and before the imperfect verb.

topics.headline: lengthening delays the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the negating boundary held before the association verb is spoken.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe recitational weight on the local negator without changing its grammatical scope.

words.gloss_range: associate or assign a partner; locally first-person negated imperfect in a preposition-plus-object frame, denying any produced partnership relation
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, allotment, and religious association; locally narrowed to illicit association as an assigned relation with a Lord-reference point and an excluded object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional complement marking the one with whom association would be made
direct object naming the excluded candidate class

words.prose: {{ar:أُشْرِكُ}} ({{tr:ushriku}}) is the verb where the ayah's refusal becomes relational. The first-person imperfect denies an ongoing stance of assigning anyone into partnership, and the Form IV frame makes the speaker's agency in making that relation visible. The sharing field is narrowed here to illicit religious association: no candidate is granted any share with Him. The verb does not stand alone: its prepositional complement fixes the one with whom association would be made, and its object supplies the excluded candidate, so the denial unfolds as act, relation point, then excluded object under the opening command. This singular prophetic refusal also echoes the collective refusal in 72:2 and stands beside the wider worship-and-nonassociation formula of 4:36. The tight consonant texture marks the forbidden relational knot and anticipates the broader no-one exclusion in 72:22.

topics.headline: speaker denies ongoing association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the refusal as the speaker's own continuing stance, embedded in the verb morphology.
topics.reason: The verb is a first-person imperfect under negation inside the quoted utterance.

topics.headline: Form IV makes partnership assigned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied act is producing or assigning a partnership relation, not merely observing shared existence.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form IV, and the CRITICAL rows' causative-assignment payoff fits the local association frame.

topics.headline: verb requires relation point and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the denial through its full frame: act, relation point, and excluded object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the verb both a preposition-governed pronoun and the direct object at the end of the clause.

topics.headline: sharing field narrows to shirk
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the partnership/share field behind the verb, while local negation and Lord-reference narrow it to illicit religious association.
topics.reason: The root field includes sharing and partnership, but the local frame is negated association with the Lord-reference pronoun.

topics.headline: negative verb answers the call verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exclusive worship defined by both direction of invocation and refusal of partnership.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the negated verb with the earlier invocation verb.

topics.headline: nonassociation echoes across declarations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the singular refusal here as aligned with the collective refusal in 72:2 and with the worship-nonassociation command pattern in 4:36.
topics.reason: The cited references support comparison of nonassociation formulas without changing the local first-person singular form.

topics.headline: association field meets Lord and anyone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the association verb positioned between Lordship, anyone-exclusion, and commanded declaration.
topics.reason: The local clause itself contains the Lord-reference complement and final anyone-object under the command frame.

topics.headline: sound marks forbidden relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the tight sound of the association verb and see its refusal anticipate the broader no-one exclusion in 72:22.
topics.reason: The sound note and same-surah anticipation add local texture without contradicting the verb frame.

words.gloss_range: with Him; locally a preposition plus pronoun marking the divine relation point in the association frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the antecedent resumed by the pronoun
the final excluded object after the relation point

words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) gives the refusal its relation point. The preposition marks the one with whom another would be associated, while the attached pronoun resumes the Lord named in the positive clause. That compression lets the second clause move quickly from named Lordship to forbidden attachment without changing referents. Its held surface sustains that specific referent just before the final exclusion arrives. Its position before the final object keeps the Lord-reference in view first, so the last word can close on the total excluded class.

topics.headline: preposition marks forbidden attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the issue is not a free object alone but a relation of attaching another with Him.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as the prepositional complement governed within the association frame.

topics.headline: pronoun keeps same Lord in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same referent from the positive invocation into the negative boundary.
topics.reason: The pronoun suffix is resolved to the earlier possessed Lord, not to a new referent.

topics.headline: one word compresses relation and referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the word fuses the forbidden relation marker with the referent it resumes.
topics.reason: The bundle contains the preposition and suffix in one word, and attachment evidence gives it semantic role inside the verb frame.

topics.headline: relation point comes before anyone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Lord-reference fixed before the final excluded class lands.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the final direct object in the local word order.

topics.headline: held pronoun leads to closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the specific referent carried into the final universal exclusion.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe recitational movement from the pronoun into the final object.

words.gloss_range: anyone, any single one; locally an indefinite accusative object under negation, closing the association clause with exhaustive exclusion
words.root_gloss_range: oneness, singularity, someone/anyone, and uniqueness formulas; locally selected as an excluded participant under negation, not a predicate of divine identity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the negated verb governing the final object

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدًۭا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}) is the ayah's terminal excluded object. Its indefiniteness under negation expands the object slot from one candidate to anyone at all, while its accusative role keeps it as the participant refused from association, not as a divine predicate like the oneness formula in 112:1. The singular-anyone pressure targets every possible individual claimant rather than a broad thing-term, and it balances the one possessed Lord invoked earlier against every possible other. The final position matters: after the verb and relation point, the ayah ends on the total absence of any partner, with the final indefinite ending and fresh onset making that landing audible. Same-surah recurrence links this closure to no-one formulas in 72:18 and 72:22.

topics.headline: indefinite becomes exhaustive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the denial expand from no named partner to no one at all.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite accusative object under negation in the association clause.

topics.headline: case makes it excluded participant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes this object of refused association from a statement predicating divine oneness.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as direct object of the negated verb, not as a nominative predicate.

topics.headline: singularity pressures universal exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels singularity working under negation: every possible individual claimant is ruled out, while the word remains an object rather than a broad thing-term.
topics.reason: The root field supports singular/anyone pressure, and the unsuffixed indefinite form keeps the candidate class unrestricted.

topics.headline: final word seals the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close on the excluded class, with no qualifier after it to limit the denial.
topics.reason: The word is the last word of the ayah and the direct object of the negated association verb.

topics.headline: oneness formula redirected into object slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare the uniqueness formula in 112:1 with this ayah's grammar, where the same singular field excludes every rival from association.
topics.reason: The cross-reference is concrete, but local accusative object grammar controls how the singularity field functions here.

topics.headline: same-surah no-one formulas recur
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this final no-one exclusion linked to nearby same-surah exclusions around calling and refuge (72:18, 72:22).
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah references preserve a local recurrence pattern without changing the local syntax.

topics.headline: one Lord faces any claimant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the contrast between the one possessed Lord invoked and the indefinite any-one excluded.
topics.reason: The earlier possessed Lord is the pronoun antecedent in the negative clause, while this final word names the excluded object.

topics.headline: sound marks final indefinite landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the final indefinite object land as a distinct terminal unit.
topics.reason: The indefinite ending and final position reinforce the same indefinite-object payoff already licensed by grammar.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restriction in innama ad'u, followed by la ushriku bihi ahadan.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling is confined to the Lord, while negated partnership plus exhaustive ahad closes every possible co-recipient slot.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech to draw near supplies the focus act and makes its recipient the mechanism's hinge.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the sole endpoint to which the call is directed.
Sharing and partnership supply the relation explicitly barred from the act of invocation.
Exhaustive anyone under negation extends the exclusion from one rival to every eligible participant.

changed_reading.before: A personal statement that the speaker worships his Lord and avoids association.
changed_reading.after: A total recipient boundary: the call draws toward the Lord alone and leaves no share for any co-recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive relation in rabbi within ad'u rabbi.
baseline_models.mechanism: The invoked Lord is not only a sovereign title but the one who repairs, nurtures, and brings the caller toward completion; my marks dependence on that care, not control over it.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an ongoing formative relation rather than a bare label.
Ownership and authority keep the formative relation asymmetrical: the caller depends on the Lord.
The near-drawing call turns that lordship relation into an enacted appeal.

changed_reading.before: Rabbi is a generic divine title naming the object of prayer.
changed_reading.after: Rabbi names the sole authority whose continuing care forms the caller, so invocation enacts dependence on nurture and completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative qul externalizes the first-person confession that follows.
baseline_models.mechanism: A held doctrine becomes mandated utterance: the speaker must make the non-partnership boundary audible rather than keep it as an inward conviction.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the public medium through which the focus stance must be exposed.
Speech as belief or doctrine lets the imperative carry a held position into public articulation.
Partnership supplies the social relation that the uttered boundary refuses.
Exhaustive anyone gives the public refusal universal scope.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an inwardly held monotheistic conviction.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs a required public boundary, audibly refusing every negotiated share in invocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus command to speak is downstream of hidden disclosure, attentive reception, and recitable content, so its authority is receptive and relay-like rather than self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the revised model in the focus imperative.
Knowledge cast in hidden fashion supplies disclosure prior to the speaker's public utterance.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns reception into the prerequisite for faithful relay.
Reading and recitation supply formed verbal content that can pass from reception into speech.

structural_cues: 72:1 opens with the same imperative and sequences disclosure, attentive hearing, and the hearers' report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden disclosure, hearing-as-compliance, recitation, and the repeated imperative. I infer that the focus voice derives authority by relaying received content; a live alternative is that qul only frames a formula without specifying a general speech ethic.

changed_reading.before: Qul simply makes a private conviction public.
changed_reading.after: Qul commissions a received statement: the speaker's authority lies in faithful transmission, not independent authorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus utterance stands against speech falsely attributed to God, speech that crosses its limit, and outright falsehood; saying becomes an accountable boundary practice.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the focus act whose truth conditions are sharpened by context.
False saying or attribution supplies the nearby corrupt counterpart to commanded truthful speech.
Excessive crossing of a limit marks what speech about God must not do.
Falsehood as the opposite of truth supplies the explicit failure that the focus saying resists.

structural_cues: 72:4-5 repeat saying about God and qualify it as boundary-crossing and false before 72:20 is commanded as saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, excess, and falsehood in prior speech about God. I assign those scenes a contrastive arrow into the focus imperative; a live alternative is that they condemn earlier speakers without defining every function of qul in 72:20.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is merely ordered to announce his devotional allegiance.
changed_reading.after: The speaker is ordered to make a tightly bounded claim that neither invents for God nor exceeds what can be truthfully said.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed refuge with non-divine agents increases burden, while no protector can shield the speaker from God and no side refuge can be found; exclusive invocation reroutes protective reliance to the Lord rather than outsourcing it.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw near supplies the focus action through which reliance is rerouted.
Lordship and authority identify the relation that displaces rival protection networks.
Partnership supplies the prohibited distribution of reliance among multiple agents.
Protective recourse supplies the failed alternative channel against which exclusive calling is read.
Increase and growth supply the directional result: the attempted refuge amplifies rather than relieves the condition.
Burdensome imposition names what the rival refuge increases.
Protective neighborhood or pledged shelter supplies the protection the speaker denies anyone can provide against God.
Leaning toward a refuge supplies the lateral escape route that the speaker cannot find.

structural_cues: 72:6 makes refuge in other agents worsen the burden, and 72:22 denies both shielding from God and an alternate refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed refuge, increased burden, and the later denial of protective or lateral escape. I infer that the focus call positively reroutes dependence rather than only naming a ritual recipient; a live alternative is the narrower reading of invocation as worship without a protection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse excludes other objects from a ritual act of prayer.
changed_reading.after: The verse dismantles a protection network: reliance is called back from burden-producing intermediaries to the Lord alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plural, divergent tracks are followed by straightness on the path and then by testing, turning away, remembrance, and being routed into consequence; exclusive calling functions as maintenance of a single alignment under trial.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw near anchors route maintenance in the focus act of directed approach.
Refused partnership prevents the directed act from being distributed across competing alignments.
An extended path supplies the spatial substrate on which communal difference is pictured.
Divergent paths and factions pluralize the available alignments that the focus refuses to combine.
Straightness and balance supply the corrective posture toward a single route.
The extended path supplies the route on which straightness is sustained.
Testing a person or metal makes continued alignment a condition exposed under pressure.
Turning one's side supplies the movement away from maintained orientation.
Remembrance running on the tongue connects verbal practice to continued orientation toward the Lord.
Penetrating along a path supplies the consequential routing that follows turning away.

structural_cues: 72:11 names divergent paths; 72:16-17 narrows to straightness on the path, abundance as test, and the consequence of turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural paths, straightness, testing, turning away, voiced remembrance, and consequential routing. I infer that exclusive invocation helps maintain one alignment through the test; a live alternative is that the path sequence governs conduct broadly without specifically defining prayer.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive invocation identifies one recipient rather than several.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive invocation also acts as route discipline, repeatedly aligning the caller toward one Lord while plural tracks and tests pull elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: A God-owned worship space, a prohibition on co-invocation, a servant standing to call, and a crowd piling around him turn the focus confession into a public recipient boundary maintained under collective density.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the focus boundary audible inside the public scene.
Calling to draw near anchors the scene's contested action in the focus.
Exhaustive anyone keeps crowd size from opening even one co-recipient position.
A place of prostration supplies the God-owned setting in which address is regulated.
Calling to draw near supplies the general prohibition immediately preceding the speaker's particular confession.
Exhaustive anyone makes the preceding plural prohibition coextensive with the focus refusal.
Submissive worship identifies the standing caller by service rather than social dominance.
Calling to draw near repeats the focus action at the center of the crowd scene.
A piled, overlapping multitude supplies the horizontal pressure around the singularly directed call.

structural_cues: 72:18-20 moves from a plural prohibition, through the standing servant and piled crowd, to an imperative first-person confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a regulated worship setting, a servant's call, and a piled multitude immediately before the focus. I infer that the confession maintains recipient integrity under crowd pressure; a live alternative is that the crowd gathers in eager attention rather than opposition or coercion.

changed_reading.before: The speaker privately states whom he invokes.
changed_reading.after: The speaker voices a non-negotiable address boundary in public: collective proximity cannot become partnership in the call.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate denial of possessing harm or right direction for the audience prevents my Lord and exclusive invocation from becoming a claim of delegated control, mediation, or guaranteed outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw near anchors the dependence that must be distinguished from possessing outcomes.
Lordship and authority locate control with the Lord rather than with the caller.
Possession and disposal supply the agency explicitly denied to the speaker.
Harm and loss supply one class of outcome the speaker cannot dispense.
Sound handling and right action supply the beneficial outcome the speaker likewise cannot own for others.

structural_cues: 72:21 immediately follows the exclusive invocation statement with another qul and a first-person denial of power over the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the denial of possession over both harmful and rightly directing outcomes. I infer that this qualifies the focus possessive and exclusivity as dependence rather than proxy authority; a live alternative is that 72:21 limits only particular outcomes without addressing every kind of mediation.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive access to my Lord could sound like a claim to privileged control on the audience's behalf.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive invocation is a confession of dependence: the caller neither owns the Lord nor controls harm, benefit, or guidance for others.

context_deltas.mechanism: After denying power, the speaker retains delivery from God and His messages as his positive scope; the final accounting of delivered messages confirms that the commanded voice is bounded by transmission.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the mandate whose permitted scope is defined by delivery.
Conveying a message supplies the positive task left after the speaker denies control.
Messenger and message supply the commission whose content the focus utterance carries.
Completed message delivery supplies the closing criterion by which the voice's task is measured.
The closing messages reconnect successful delivery to the messenger role rather than autonomous authority.

structural_cues: 72:21-23 moves from denied power to the exception of delivery, while 72:28 closes by verifying that the messages were delivered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied power, message delivery, messenger identity, and closing verification. I infer that these define the functional perimeter of qul; a live alternative is that the exception in 72:23 has a narrower syntactic attachment, though delivery still remains the adjacent positive commission.

changed_reading.before: Qul authorizes a forceful personal declaration.
changed_reading.after: Qul authorizes only accountable transmission: the speaker's strength is reaching the addressee with the message, not adding power or content of his own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker disclaims knowledge of timing; unseen knowledge remains concealed unless God discloses it to a chosen messenger, guards its route, and completely encompasses and counts the delivery. Exclusive invocation therefore does not create unsupervised occult access.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the epistemically bounded statement in the focus command.
Calling to draw near anchors the relation that must not be mistaken for unrestricted knowledge access.
Knowledge and discernment supply the capacity the speaker explicitly leaves uncertain.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the protected knowledge domain that belongs to God.
Emergence and disclosure supply the controlled transition from hidden knowledge to what a messenger may receive.
Approval and acceptance supply the selection condition for disclosure.
Messenger and message supply the authorized human endpoint of selective disclosure.
Watchful guarding supplies protection around the disclosure and delivery route.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies divine oversight of what is with the messengers.
Exact enumeration and exhaustive accounting supply the audit boundary around delivery.

structural_cues: 72:25-28 moves from the speaker's uncertainty to selective disclosure, guards before and behind the messenger, and complete divine accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human uncertainty, hidden knowledge, selective disclosure, guarding, and exhaustive oversight. I infer that the focus relation grants a commissioned channel but not autonomous access; a live alternative is that the guards protect the message specifically rather than qualifying every utterance or prayer.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive calling to my Lord could imply privileged access to divine secrets.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive calling remains epistemically humble: whatever is spoken arrives through a selected, guarded, and fully audited disclosure channel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the path-rut branch of sh-r-k rather than its direct partnership sense. It remains anchored in focus ushriku and gains visible support from divergent paths followed by straightness on the path. Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain spatial resonance, never as a replacement for the lexical prohibition of association.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb ushriku, read through its branch image of rutted and branching tracks.

activation_trace.role: Road ruts and main tracks supply an exploratory spatial image for invocation that refuses to branch.
An extended path supplies the same spatial domain elsewhere in the packet.
Divergent paths and factions make branching a live contextual image rather than an isolated pun.
Straightness and balance supply the counter-motion to branching.
The singular extended path supplies the route on which the caller remains aligned.

changed_reading.before: I do not assign a partner in my invocation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, I do not let invocation split into rival ruts; it stays on one directed route to my Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because focus q-w-l reaches q-l-l only through the packet's non-dominant split mapping, not through the ordinary speech target. It remains formally anchored in focus qul and is reactivated by fewer supporters and number in 72:24. Downstream prose must label it a packet-authorized split-root resonance, not claim that qul lexically means fewness.

strongest_changes: Exclusive invocation became a rerouting of protective reliance away from burden-producing intermediaries.
The imperative became received, truth-bounded, and accountable delivery rather than autonomous religious speech.
The 72:18-20 sequence turned a private confession into a public recipient boundary maintained amid a piled crowd.
The immediate denial of power in 72:21 stripped my Lord of any implication that the caller owns outcomes or acts as a controlling proxy.
The closing disclosure sequence made exclusive calling compatible with uncertainty and subordinate to a guarded, fully audited knowledge channel.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse sits at the hinge between a crowded invocation scene and a cascade of denials about power, refuge, knowledge, and authorship. That placement converts a short confession into disciplined address: singular in recipient, public under pressure, dependent rather than controlling, and bounded by delivery.
remaining_uncertainties: The piled crowd in 72:19 may signal opposition, eager gathering, or both, so crowd resistance should not be overstated.
The exact syntactic reach of the delivery exception in 72:23 remains open even though delivery is clearly the nearby positive commission.
The route and fewness outliers are branch resonances, not lexical replacements, and require explicit exploratory qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The call is an exclusive act of affiliation.** `قل` activates ق و ل B001, public utterance; `أدعو` activates د ع و B001-B002, calling near and claiming affiliation; `ربي` activates ر ب ب B001-B002; `أشرك` activates ش ر ك B001-B002; and `أحدا` activates ء ح د B002. `إنما` and the coordinated negation define the call by excluding every partner. The inferred mechanism is relational: invocation establishes affiliation, so a second object would divide that relation. The ayah reads as the first-person enactment of 72:18, not merely its repetition.

2. **Speech answers crowd-pressure with role clarity.** The command `قل` follows 72:19’s ambiguous piling and redirects attention from the crowd’s motive to the servant’s own bounded action. ق و ل B016, definition or essence stated as speech, is activated by this compact self-definition. The inferred move is that public clarification counters social compression without claiming control over the audience. The ayah reads as a boundary statement about practice.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The denials of outcome-control and refuge in 72:21-22, followed by the conveyance exception in 72:23, sharpen this statement into a role boundary: exclusive invocation does not imply possession of divine powers.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The command reopens the accountable relay.** Fixed `ق و ل` B001 is articulated speech. The imperative `قُلْ` returns to the form that opened 72:1, now after the servant's call and crowding in 72:19; it makes the first-person declaration itself an instructed utterance. The packet supplies external command, public pressure, and quoted response; I infer that the speaker does not improvise allegiance to manage the crowd. `قُلْ` reads as source-control under pressure.

2. **Invocation draws near only the formative Lord.** Fixed `د ع و` B001 is calling that draws a recipient near; fixed `ر ب ب` B001 is lordship/authority and B002 nurture and completion stage by stage. The restrictive `إِنَّمَا` makes this relation the sole destination of the call, while the next ayah denies that the caller himself owns either harm or right course. The packet supplies exclusive call, formative authority, and the caller's limited capacity; I infer that invocation is directed to the source of outcomes rather than to their messenger. `أَدْعُوا رَبِّي` reads as relational dependence with a specific causal rationale.

3. **Exclusive calling is the inverse of partnership architecture.** Fixed `ش ر ك` B001 is bringing another into shared participation and B008 is a divided/preoccupied mind. `إِنَّمَا` positively restricts the addressee, `لَا` excludes participation, and fixed `ء ح د` B002 exhausts every possible someone. The packet supplies positive concentration, negative exclusion, and exhaustive scope; I infer that undivided invocation and undivided allegiance are one mechanism. The two halves read as mutually specifying rather than repetitive.

4. **The singular practice models the plural prohibition.** In 72:18 the audience receives plural `لَا تَدْعُوا`; here the servant says singular `أَدْعُوا` and `لَا أُشْرِكُ`. The packet supplies rule and enacted example in immediate sequence; I infer that the public declaration operationalizes the spatial ownership claim of the mosques. The fixed ayah reads as demonstration, not only profession.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:21-23 immediately delimit this exclusive practice: the caller owns neither harm nor right course, cannot shelter himself, and is responsible for delivery. Ayat 72:26-28 then show the positive source-control structure anticipated by fixed `قُلْ`: unseen disclosure is approved, guarded, and audited from the source. Exclusive calling therefore concentrates allegiance without enlarging the servant into an outcome-owner.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Exclusive Invocation Exposes the Difference between Mass and Support
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies can orient, gather, and pile around a single act of worship, but physical mass does not confer shared divine agency or effective support.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The crowd first appears as compressed material and is later analytically decomposed into capacity and count, reversing the visual impression of overwhelming mass.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sacred posture and calling converge on one center
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A consecrated place gathers lowered bodies and directs vocal appeal toward a single recipient, excluding every partner and rival claimant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prostration and self-lowering (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); place of prostration (`quranic:root_000675:B002/m01`); bodily points of contact in prostration (`quranic:root_000675:B003/m01`); bowed head and body (`quranic:root_000675:B004/m01`); fixed lowered gaze (`quranic:root_000675:B005/m01`); vocal summons (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); claim of right or affiliation (`quranic:root_000478:B002/m01`); worship and the worshiped (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); singularity (`quranic:root_000017:B001/m01`); exhaustive exclusion (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`); shared participation (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`); religious partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Worship is built as a coordinated bodily-vocal scene: feet, knees, hands, face, bowed head, gaze, place, and call all point toward one center. The claim sense of calling clarifies why partnership is excluded: invocation cannot be used to establish a rival title or affiliation within the sacred space.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Delegated Speech Carries No Proprietary Agency
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The messenger has custody of a commission but no ownership title over its outcomes and no independent protection against its source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Prophetic limitation is expressed through property, indemnity, asylum, and delivery law: no title to effects, no shelter outside the principal, and one bounded duty of transfer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Harm and rectitude are not the speaker's property
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker disclaims possession, sovereign disposal, and the structural means by which either injury or sound direction could be independently guaranteed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: structural cohesion and control (`quranic:root_001444:B001/m01`); legal possession and disposal (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); sovereignty and rule (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); the support on which an affair depends (`quranic:root_001444:B005/m01`); water as the resource that gives a traveler control (`quranic:root_001444:B007/m01`); injury and diminution (`quranic:root_000907:B001/m01`); mutual infliction of injury (`quranic:root_000907:B002/m01`); coercive necessity (`quranic:root_000907:B003/m01`); straight guidance (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`); sound disposal (`quranic:root_000565:B002/m01`); lordship (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Ownership is unfolded into title, sovereign power, structural control, and access to the resource that lets a traveler manage his condition. The disclaimer removes each basis of independent agency. Harm and rectitude are not wares in the messenger's hand, nor does he possess the infrastructure that would let him produce either at will.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluğun karşıtı olan sayı ve miktar azlığını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmadığının söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel azlık durumunu doğal bir Türkçe yapıyla tam olarak verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Azlığın kişide yoksulluk ve toplumsal düşüklük sonucu doğurduğu bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk ile düşüklük arasındaki kaynakta kurulan uzantıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir miktarın veya verilen bir şeyin yetersiz ya da küçük sayıldığı değerlendirme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sıklığı çok düşüren veya olumsuzluğu pekiştiren kalıplaşmış yapılarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birini ses ve söz yoluyla kendine doğru yöneltme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaklaşmayı isteyen kalıplaşmış bir emir ve ünlem işlevi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir muhatabı konuşana ya da belirtilen noktaya yaklaşmaya yöneltir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel çağırma eylemidir; komşu dal ise yaklaşma isteğini bildiren belirli bir emir ifadesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Seslenme aracılığıyla muhatabın yönelmesini sağlayan eylemi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yakın veya uzak muhataba seslenmede kullanılan çağrı parçacıklarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir muhataba yöneltilen sözlü çağrı alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çağırma eyleminin kendisini tanımlar; komşu dal o eylemde kullanılan dil bilgisel seslenme araçlarını tanımlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı. Yayınlanan üç komşu, çağırma eylemini yüksek ses, yaklaşma emri ve seslenme parçacığından ayırır; diğer adaylar ya daha uzak bir ortak sahne paylaşır ya da kardeş dallardaki ayrı anlamları yineler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ileri sürmesini temel alır; soy ve çocuk bağı iddiası ile savaşta soyunu bildirerek kendini tanıtmayı aynı iddia alanında özel biçimler olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Hak ileri sürme, soy bağı kurma ve savaşta aidiyet bildirme ayrımları korunur; bunlar sıradan seslenme anlamına indirgenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel hak ileri sürme biçimi ile soy ve savaş bağlamlarına bağlı yapılar ayrı tutulur; özel kullanımlar yalın biçimin tamamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ya da aidiyet bağı ileri sürmesidir. Soy veya çocuk bağı kurma ve savaşta soyunu söyleyerek kendini tanıtma, bu iddia eyleminin özel biçimleridir.

facets.statement: Bir hak, kişinin kendisi ya da başka biri lehine ileri sürülür.
Bir çocuk veya kişi için soy bağı ileri sürülerek onu belirli bir babaya ya da soya bağlama anlamı vardır.
Savaş bağlamında kişi soyunu söyleyerek kendini ve bağlı olduğu topluluğu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu iddia, hak ileri sürme çekirdeği yanında soy veya çocuk bağı kurmayı ve savaşta soy bildirerek kendini tanıtmayı birbirinden ayrılan özel gerçekleşmeler olarak kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bir hak talebini hem de soy veya topluluk bağı iddiasını ortak çekirdekte anlatmak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İleri sürme eylemini, hak konusunu ve aidiyet bağı kurulabilmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ileri sürdüğü bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir hakka sahip olunduğunu ileri sürme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Soy bağı ve savaşta aidiyet bildirme kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiyi belirli bir baba, soy veya toplulukla ilişkilendiren iddia için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Soy ilişkisini iddia yoluyla kurma anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Soy dışındaki hak iddialarını ve savaş bağlamındaki kendini tanıtma işlevini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin savaş sırasında hangi soydan geldiğini söyleyerek kendini tanıttığı özel kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Savaş bağlamını, soy bildirimini ve kendini tanıtma işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel hak iddiasını ve başkasına soy bağı yükleme kullanımını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kendisi veya başkası adına hak iddia etme

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiye yönelen eylem düşüncesini çok genel biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Hak veya aidiyet ileri sürme işlemini bütünüyle kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Sesli bir çağrı yapıldığı anlamını gereksiz yere ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün çağırma dalıyla karışır ve bu dalın iddia sınırını bozar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hak iddiasını, savaşta soy bildirimini ve kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına ileri sürülen bağı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin bir topluluğa veya öz babası dışındaki birine eklenmesi sonucuna odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin soy veya topluluk bağına iddia yoluyla yerleştirilmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal daha geniş bir iddia alanına sahiptir; komşu dal özellikle kişinin başka bir soya ya da babaya bağlanması işlemiyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir hak veya soy bağı ileri sürme niteliğini taşır ve ileri sürülen bağ doğru ya da yanlış olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişiyi babasına ya da topluluğuna bağlama ve o aidiyeti bildirme eylemini iddia niteliği aramadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Soy veya topluluk aidiyetini dile getirme ve savaşta bu bağla tanınma alanları ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda bağ bir iddia olarak ortaya konur; komşuda ağırlık, var olan aidiyeti bir baba veya topluluğa bağlayarak bildirmededir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Soy bağını ileri sürülen bir hak veya iddia olarak ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Akrabalık bağlarını, soy bilgisini ve kişi, yer ya da mesleğe nispeti geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişilerin bir soya veya topluluğa bağlanması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iddia eylemini gerektirir; komşu dal ise iddia bulunmasa da soy ve nispet ilişkilerinin kendisini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Seçilen komşular, soy iddiasını başka bir soya bağlama, aidiyet bildirme ve genel soy ilişkisi alanlarından ayırır; kalanlar daha dar tarihsel kullanımlar, uzak çağrışımlar veya kardeş dallardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlamak amacıyla memede bilerek bırakılan süt miktarını açıkça tanımlar; hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu amaç ve araç ilişkisini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca memede bırakılan sütün sonraki sütü çekmesi düşüncesine bağlıdır; genel süt kalıntısına yayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen sütçülük yapısına bağlıdır ve kökün yalın biçimine bağımsız bir anlam olarak aktarılamaz.

concept_map.definition: Sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlamak için sağım sırasında memede bilerek bırakılan süt payıdır.

facets.statement: Sağımda sütün bir bölümü memede bilerek bırakılır.
Bırakılan payın işlevi, ardından gelecek sütün akışını uyarmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, memede süt bırakma işlemini ve bu işlemin sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlama amacını ayrılmaz biçimde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: sütün devamını çekmek için memede bırakılan pay
concept_gloss.applicability: Sağımda kalan sütün tesadüfi değil, sonraki sütün gelmesini uyarmak için bilerek bırakıldığı özel kavramı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Süt payını, memede bırakılmasını ve sonraki sütü getirme amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sütçülük bağlamında, sonraki sütün akmasını sağlamak üzere memede bırakılan miktarı kısa biçimde anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bırakılan payın sağımın devamını sağlama işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Payın özellikle memede bırakıldığını ve sonraki sütü çektiğini açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sonraki sütü çekmek için memede bırakılan süt payı

error_profile.preserves: Sağım sonrasında memede bir miktar süt bulunmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Sütün bilerek bırakılmasını ve sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlama amacını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Memede kalan sütün sonraki sütü getirmesi için bilerek bırakılmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Memede kalan sütün az ve yudumluk miktarda oluşunu anlatır; özel bir işlev şart koşmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sağım sonrasında memede bulunan küçük bir süt miktarını konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalanın amacıyla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise miktarın azlığıyla tanımlanır ve sonraki sütü çekme işlevini gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süt akışını uyarmak için memede bırakılan sütün kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Memeyi sıvazlayarak sütü indirme eylemini ve bu yolla süt veren hayvanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da memeden yeni süt akışını başlatma veya sürdürme amacı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uyarıcı araç memede bırakılan süt payıdır; komşuda araç memenin sıvazlanmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir miktar sütü sonraki akışı sağlamak üzere memede bırakmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Parmak uçlarıyla az az sağmayı, yavaş akışı ve kalan sütü çekip almayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da memedeki az miktardaki süt ve sağımın sürdürülmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sütü bırakır ve işlevini bekler; komşu dal az miktardaki sütü belirli bir sağım biçimiyle dışarı alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi. Seçilen komşular, amaçlı bırakılan süt payını az süt kalıntısından, memeyi sıvazlamaktan ve az az sağmaktan ayırır; öteki adaylar sağımın başka aşamalarına veya kardeş anlamlara aittir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanan çerçeve bunu birine kötülük gelmesi için söz söyleme olarak sunarken kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'nın kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı şeyi getirmesini ve olayın gerçekleşmesini anlatır. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım sözlü dilekten gerçekleşen sıkıntıya kaydırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, belirli yapıda Tanrı'nın istenmeyen bir şeyi kişinin başına getirmesidir; kötülük dileme eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Düzeltilen anlam yalnızca verilen Tanrı, kişi ve istenmeyen sonuç yapısında geçerlidir; yalın çağırma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapıda, Tanrı'nın bir kişinin başına onun hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntıyı getirmesini anlatır. Odak, birinin kötülük dilemesi değil, istenmeyen olayın kişiye yönelip gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Tanrı, kişiye onun hoşlanmadığı bir şeyi yöneltir ve başına getirir.
Kaynak açıklaması sözlü bir kötülük isteğini değil, istenmeyen sonucun kişide gerçekleşmesini öne çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak iddiası, Tanrı'nın bir kişiye hoşlanmadığı şeyi indirmesi veya başına getirmesi sonucunu bildirir; sözlü bir kötülük dileme işlemi belirtmez.

concept_gloss.text: Tanrı'nın birine istemediği bir sıkıntıyı vermesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Tanrı'nın bir kişinin başına o kişinin hoşlanmadığı bir olay veya sıkıntı getirdiğini bildiren özel yapı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleyenin Tanrı olmasını, etkilenen kişiyi ve onun istemediği sonucun gerçekleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eyleyeni geri planda bırakıp kişi açısından gerçekleşen istenmeyen sonucu anlatmak gerektiğinde kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntının gelmesi sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Sonucu Tanrı'nın meydana getirdiğini açıkça belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı'nın birinin başına hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntıyı getirmesi

error_profile.loses: Kaynakta bildirilen gerçekleşmiş ilahi yöneltme ve meydana gelme ilişkisini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Bir insanın sözlü istekte bulunduğu ayrı bir konuşma eylemi ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sonucun gerçekleşmesini, o sonucun gerçekleşmesini isteme eylemiyle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı'nın istenmeyen şeyi kişinin başına getirmesi ve sonucun gerçekleşmesi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin başkasına kötülük yönelten söz söylemesi öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirli bir kişinin başına kötü bir şey gelmesi düşüncesini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçekleşen ilahi yöneltmeyi bildirir; komşu dal ise kötü sonucun gerçekleşmesi için söylenen sözü anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İstenmeyen sonucun Tanrı tarafından kişiye verilmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Lanetleme ve karşılıklı olarak yalancının cezalandırılmasını isteme törenlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da Tanrı ile ilişkilendirilen kötü bir sonucun kişiye yönelmesi sahnesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sonuç bildiren özel bir yapıdır; komşu dal sözlü lanetleme veya karşılıklı sınama eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sıkıntının belirli bir eyleyen tarafından kişiye getirilmesi ilişkisini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı, zarar veya güçlüğün kendisini ve onun yoğunluğunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin yaşadığı hoş olmayan ve zarar verici durumu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sıkıntının kişiye yöneltilmesini anlatır; komşu dal yönelten bir eyleyen gerektirmeden sıkıntı durumunu adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı süreci açıkça verir: duvarların birbiri ardından çökmesi ve yapıların birbiri ardından yıkılması. Hazırlanan çerçeve, ardışıklığı ve çökme ile ettirgen yıkma ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Birbiri ardından gerçekleşme her iki kullanımda da kurucudur; tek bir çökme veya tek seferde yıkma dalın tamamını karşılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kendiliğinden ardışık çöküş ile bir eyleyenin ardışık yıkması ayrı yapılara bağlı iki facet olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yapının parçalarının birbiri ardından çökmesi veya bir eyleyenin onları birbiri ardından yıkmasıdır. Her iki durumda da tek olay değil, birbirini izleyen bir bozulma dizisi vardır.

facets.statement: Yapısal bozulma tek seferde değil, parçaların birbirini izlemesiyle gerçekleşir.
Duvarlar veya yapı parçaları kendiliğinden birbiri ardından çöker.
Bir eyleyen, yapı parçalarını hedefin üzerine birbiri ardından yıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, ardışık çöküşü ve ardışık ettirgen yıkmayı aynı sıra ilişkisi altında birleştirir; eyleyenin bulunup bulunmaması iki kullanımı ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem yapı parçalarının sırayla çökmesini hem de bir eyleyenin onları sırayla yıkmasını kapsayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ardışıklığı, yapısal bozulmayı ve kendiliğinden çökme ile ettirgen yıkma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duvar veya yapı parçalarının kendiliğinden ve sırayla düştüğü kullanım için doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapı parçalarının ardışık biçimde çökmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir eyleyenin parçaları birbiri ardından yıkması kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eyleyenin yapı parçalarını hedefin üzerine sırayla yıktığı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen yıkmayı ve parçaların sıra ile devrilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yapının kendiliğinden ardışık çökmesi kullanımını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Yapının ayakta kalma durumunu yitirerek düşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Parçaların birbiri ardından gelmesini ve ettirgen yıkma kullanımını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çöküşün veya yıkmanın parçalar arasında sıra halinde ilerlemesini ve ettirgen seçeneği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin genel olarak düşmesi veya yıkılmasını, ayrıca ağacın kökünden çıkmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir yapının ayakta kalma durumunu yitirip çökmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için ardışıklık kurucudur; komşu dal tek bir çöküşü de kapsar ve sıra ilişkisi gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birbiri ardından çökme veya yıkma düzenini vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yıkılmanın taşıyıcı düzeni, gücü veya itibarı ortadan kaldıran sonucunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yapıların yıkılması ve ayakta tutan düzenin bozulması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal olayların sırasıyla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise yıkımın dayanıklılığı ve düzeni yok eden sonucuyla tanımlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birden çok parçanın birbirini izleyerek çökmesini veya yıkılmasını gerektirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dönemin değişimlerini ve olayların yönünü değiştirmelerini anlatır. Hazırlanan çerçevenin olaylar ve yön verme bölümü uygundur, ancak insanın bu olaylara eğilmesi kaynakta kurucu bir katılımcı olarak açıkça verilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım, insanın yönelmesini değil, dönemin olayların akışını başka yöne çeviren değişimlerini merkeze alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca dönemin yön verici değişimleri yapısına bağlıdır; yalın biçime genel bir olay veya çağırma anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dönemin olayların akışını başka yöne çeviren değişimleri ve getirdiği gelişmelerdir. Yöneltme düşüncesi burada sesli bir çağrı değil, olayların seyrine etki eden mecazlı bir güçtür.

facets.statement: Dönem, değişen koşullar ve gelişmeler yoluyla olayların akışına yön verir.
Olayların başka yöne çevrilmesi, temel yöneltme ilişkisini zamansal değişimlere taşıyan mecazlı bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, dönemin değişimlerini olayların yönünü etkileyen güçler olarak sunar; insanın bu değişimlere çekilmesi kaynak ifadesinde zorunlu bir öğe değildir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dönemin getirdiği değişimlerin olayların seyrini etkilediğini anlatan özel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Bu değişimlerin olayların yönünü çevirdiği mecazlı ilişkiyi açıkça göstermez.

error_profile.loses: Dönemin değişimleri ile olayların seyrinin yön değiştirmesi arasındaki bağı zayıflatır.

error_profile.collision: Olayların yönünün değişmesi ile insanın olaylara kapılması birbirine karışır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, gizlenmiş cevabı ortaya çıkarmak için karşılıklı olarak sorulan bilmece türü soruları ve birine böyle bir soru yöneltme eylemini birlikte verir. Hazırlanan çerçeve bu soru, gizleme ve cevap çıkarma ilişkisini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıradan anlaşılmaz sözü değil, gizlenmiş bir cevabı buldurmak üzere yöneltilen bilmece ve sınama eylemini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bilmece olarak kullanılan adlandırma ile birine bilmece yöneltme eylemi ayrı facetlerde korunur; anlam genel seslenmeye yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gizlenmiş bir cevabı ortaya çıkarmak için birine yöneltilen bilmece türü soru veya böyle sorularla karşılıklı sınamadır. Soru, muhatabı örtülü cevabı bulup söylemeye çağırır.

facets.statement: Soru, cevabı doğrudan vermeyip onu örtülü ve çözülmesi gereken halde sunar.
Kişiler bu tür soruları birbirlerine yönelterek karşılıklı bir sınama yürütür.
Eylem biçimi, muhataba bir bilmece sunup gizli cevabı ondan istemeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, bilmece niteliğindeki örtülü soruyu, bu sorularla karşılıklı sınamayı ve muhataptan gizli cevabı çıkarma amacını birlikte temellendirir.
